newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisian treasury raises 51 mln dinars at auction.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian treasury raises 51 mln dinars at auction.

text.p: The Tunisian Treasury on Tuesday said it sold 51 million dinars of three-year notes at its weekly auction on November 5, repaying maturing paper totalling 41.4 million dinars.
It sold 41 million dinars in three-year notes payable in equal annual tranches, and 10 million dinars in three-year notes payable at maturity, both at a 9.0625 percent yield.
Banks bid for 135 million dinars of three-, and five-year notes at between 9.0625 and 9.5 percent. ($=0.98 dinar)
